title: Wrong or missing duration (12 cards)
body:
These cards have the wrong duration:

- Should end at end of turn: Koth of the Hammer (`UntilPlayersNextTurn`), Embiggen and Gollum, Scheming Guide (`UntilEndOfTheNextTurn`)
- Should end at end of combat: Tahngarth, First Mate (`UntilEndOfTurn`)
- Should have no end: Hellkite Courser, Swift Warkite, Whip of Erebos ("It gains haste"), True Polymorph, Dancing Sword (all `UntilEndOfTurn`)
- Should last the rest of the game: Choice of Fortunes (`UntilEndOfTurn`)
- Should end at end of turn: Seize the Spotlight (control change never ends), Grenzo, Havoc Raiser (permission to cast the card lasts only during resolution)
